pages.text: Lesser pieces: 20 armor, 50 toughness, 5％ immunity, 2％ speed and additive damage each. Matching set adds 20 armor, 10％ immunity and 5％ speed/damage: totals 100 armor, 30％ immunity, 13％ speed/damage. Full set: 80％ fall reduction, Resistance I, Strength II, Haste II, night and lava vision. Lava vision is not fire resistance.

Ascended pieces: 50 armor, 50 toughness, 10％ immunity, 5％ speed/additive damage each. Matching set adds 50 armor, 20％ immunity, 10％ speed/damage: totals 250 armor, 60％ immunity, 30％ speed/damage. Full set: no fall damage, Fire Resistance, Strength X, Haste X, night/lava vision. Mixed tiers only retain individual attributes.
